request: Let Upgrade pass through the forwarding helper unchanged, because our upstream uses it to choose a transport.

source.request: Let Upgrade pass through the forwarding helper unchanged, because our upstream uses it to choose a transport.
source.settled: The proxy strips Upgrade as a hop-by-hop header.
source.why: Forwarding Upgrade would undo its addition to the hop-by-hop removal list.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
